independent_verification: Required for acceptance; parser tests, CI and host canary remain separate

semantics.expected_decision: Abstract normative intent. Each implementation must document its mapping to local states and APIs.
semantics.reason_code: Normalized cross-component code, not guaranteed to equal current prototype ledger or adapter enum.
semantics.forbidden: Required negative assertion; never infer an external effect is absent from missing telemetry.
semantics.last_checked: Re-evaluate all PR heads and versions before any merge.
semantics.event_trust: Browser/model/worker events are observations, not permissions; trusted verification requires authenticated gateway.
